$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ -1 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

What is the area scale factor of the transformation?
